# 9 · Battery Install

!!! note "Stub — assembly steps coming"
    Mount and secure the main **ECO-WORTHY ~52 V LiFePO4** pack in the lower frame and land its
    power + **BMS (RS485)** connections.

!!! danger "Battery safety"
    The pack is the **heaviest single part** and a **high-energy lithium battery**. Get help lifting
    it, and keep **hands and feet clear from under the robot**. Wear **PPE** (safety glasses +
    gloves). Disconnect before wiring; never short, over-discharge, puncture, submerge, or charge a
    damaged pack, and isolate any pack that is hot, swollen, or smoking. Read the manufacturer's full
    safety + PPE guidance:
    [ECO-WORTHY battery manual (PDF)](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0253/9752/6580/files/48V_50AH_Rack_Battery_Instruction_Manual.pdf?v=1752224364).
